marketDirection.headline: Indian market is advancing today.

reasons.text: Nifty 50 closed +0.18% at 25,299, above its 20-DMA, above the 50-DMA (rising), above the 200-DMA.
The index is up 3.1% over the last five sessions — uptrend structure intact.
Market breadth is mixed — 57.7% of scanned NSE stocks advancing, 53.9% above their 50-DMA.
Strong execution numbers position the stock for a potential range breakout above ₹7,650 if broader auto weakness subsides.
Index dip below 25,150 invalidates immediate breakout follow-through and mandates disciplined position sizing across long swing setups.

marketDirection.disclaimer: A rules-based read of index price, market breadth and headline flow — not a forecast or trading advice.

marketSummary: The Indian equity market snapped its three-day advance on Friday as the Nifty 50 slipped 0.61% to close at 25,144.30 and the Sensex shed 318.56 points to settle at 81,592.45. Selling pressure accelerated following macroeconomic data showing October retail inflation spiked to 6.09%, breaching the Reserve Bank of India upper tolerance threshold for the first time in two years alongside elevated crude oil prices trading near 95 dollars per barrel. Despite sustained foreign institutional inflows exceeding 7,830 crore rupees on Thursday, market breadth turned distinctly defensive with realty, metals, and autos underperforming while select capital goods and defence names witnessed consolidation after quarterly earnings releases.
dailyFocus: Monitor reaction to Q2 earnings prints in heavyweights like Grasim and Eicher Motors while tracking post-earnings pullback levels in defence names HAL and Cochin Shipyard as headline inflation poses near-term valuation headwinds.

sectors.name: Capital Goods & Power Equipment
sectors.reason: Robust order intake and multi-year capex ramp-ups across grid infrastructure, data centres, and heavy electrical engineering insulate the sector from retail consumption softness.
catalysts: Accelerated substation and transmission grid spending
Record backlog levels providing multi-year earnings visibility
risks: Elevated raw material costs and execution delays
Subdued margin expansion in legacy industrial segments

sectors.name: Aerospace & Defence
sectors.reason: Unprecedented domestic order books and healthy revenue execution support the medium-term structure, though post-earnings margin contraction has triggered short-term base-testing.
catalysts: High domestic procurement pipeline under indigenisation mandates
LCA Mk1A delivery ramp-ups and AMCA consortium developments
risks: EBITDA margin compression from supply chain friction
Extended working capital cycles in milestone-based billing

sectors.name: Automobile & Ancillaries
sectors.reason: Festive volume expansion is offset by rate sensitivity following the 6.09% inflation reading and margin headwinds across commercial and passenger vehicle segments.
catalysts: Record festive deliveries for premium two-wheelers
Stable export demand in select international markets
risks: Hawkish RBI interest rate stance dampening retail auto financing

sectors.name: Consumer Retail & Discretionary
sectors.reason: Rapid store expansion models and value fashion outperform broader consumption, but elevated forward multiples make swing entries sensitive to broader market pullbacks.
catalysts: Network milestone additions such as Zudio expanding rapidly
High festive footfall and inventory turnaround
risks: Stretched valuation multiples leaving low cushion for execution misses
Inflation pressure on discretionary tier-2 and tier-3 consumer spending

sectors.name: Realty
sectors.reason: Rising headline inflation and expectations of prolonged high repo rates triggered heavy sectoral profit taking, causing multiple leaders to breach short-term support levels.
catalysts: Long-term structural housing demand and luxury project pipeline
risks: Persistent inflation threatening homebuyer affordability and mortgage rates
Inventory accumulation in select urban micro-markets

news.headline: Eicher Motors Q2 PAT Rises 15% to ₹1,573 Crore Powered by Record Royal Enfield Motorcycle Sales
news.summary: Eicher Motors posted its second-quarter earnings on November 13, 2026, registering a 14.9% YoY growth in consolidated net profit to ₹1,573 crore and a 20.3% increase in revenue to ₹7,422 crore. Royal Enfield achieved record quarterly volumes of 376,722 units, while joint venture VE Commercial Vehicles contributed ₹186 crore in profit share despite elevated supply costs.
news.impact: Strong execution numbers position the stock for a potential range breakout above ₹7,650 if broader auto weakness subsides.

news.headline: Nifty Snaps Three-Session Rally to Close at 25,144 as October Retail Inflation Climbs to 6.09%
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices retreated on November 13, 2026, as headline Consumer Price Index inflation rose to 6.09% in October, breaching the Reserve Bank of India 6% upper tolerance ceiling. The surge was driven by elevated food and energy costs, dampening expectations of any monetary easing and triggering profit booking across rate-sensitive counters.
news.impact: Index dip below 25,150 invalidates immediate breakout follow-through and mandates disciplined position sizing across long swing setups.

news.headline: Grasim Standalone Q2 Net Profit Zooms 187% to ₹2,306 Crore as Consolidated Books ₹767 Crore Impairment
news.summary: Grasim Industries declared Q2 FY27 financial results on November 13, 2026, with standalone net profit nearly tripling to ₹2,306 crore, supported by ₹3,968 crore dividend income from UltraTech and 33% revenue expansion. On a consolidated level, revenue climbed 26% to ₹50,105 crore, but the company booked an exceptional impairment provision of ₹767 crore on its Canadian pulp JV mill idling.
news.impact: Divergence between strong operational revenue and consolidated impairment charges creates two-way volatility, testing support near ₹3,000.

news.headline: HAL Reports 16% YoY Rise in Q2 Net Profit to ₹1,936 Crore; Operating Margin Contraction Drags Price
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹7,613 crore, up 14.9% YoY, and net profit of ₹1,936 crore on November 12, 2026. However, consolidated EBITDA margin narrowed to 22.8% from 23.5% due to higher operational expenditures, prompting a 4% intraday decline before shares stabilised near ₹4,834 amid a ₹2.5 lakh crore order pipeline.
news.impact: Operating margin compression forces a pullback toward the ₹4,730 support base, where swing traders must wait for a low-volume stabilization base.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Q2 Profit Halves to ₹54 Crore as Shipbuilding Slips; Board Declares ₹3 Interim Dividend
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard released Q2 FY27 results showing consolidated net profit slumped 50% YoY to ₹53.8 crore, down from ₹107.5 crore, despite revenue growing 11.7% to ₹1,249 crore. Operating EBITDA margins shrank 250 bps to 4.1% on steep sub-contracting and input expenses, while the board declared an interim dividend of ₹3 per share with a record date of November 16, 2026.
news.impact: A severe margin drop invalidates prior cup-and-handle breakout structures, shifting the immediate price trajectory into base breakdown defense.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures ₹909 Crore Additional Orders as H1 Order Intake Tops ₹7,500 Crore
news.summary: Bharat Electronics announced fresh order acquisitions amounting to ₹909 crore across defence electronics, communication systems, and electronic warfare upgrades. The company reaffirmed its FY27 inflow pipeline targeting over ₹55,000 crore, backed by its outstanding unexecuted order book of ₹68,717 crore reported at the close of Q2.
news.impact: Continued order accretions support structural accumulation and enhance breakout probability from its current multi-week consolidation channel.

news.headline: Foreign Institutional Investors Maintain Buying Streak with ₹7,831 Crore Equities Absorption
news.summary: Provisional exchange filings on November 13, 2026, confirmed Foreign Institutional Investors bought equities worth ₹7,830.60 crore on net basis, marking their ninth consecutive buying session. Total FII inflows for November topped 8 billion dollars, helping counterbalance domestic institutional net selling of ₹6,331.17 crore.
news.impact: Persistent heavy foreign cash inflows offer a strong downside floor, preventing deep trend breaks in frontline index pivot constituents.

news.headline: SEBI Clears Confidential Draft IPO Papers for Fintech Unicorn Razorpay and Sembcorp Green Infra
news.summary: Markets regulator SEBI on November 13, 2026, approved initial public offering papers submitted via the confidential pre-filing route by digital payments leader Razorpay and renewable energy producer Sembcorp Green Infra. The approvals pave the way for primary market fundraising drives scheduled over the next quarter.
news.impact: Renewed mega-cap primary issuance approvals signal sustained institutional risk appetite, supporting broader market valuation stability.

news.headline: Trent Consolidates at Life Highs Following 25% Q2 Profit Growth and Zudio Network Milestone
news.summary: Tata Group retail star Trent trades firmly after posting a 25% YoY growth in consolidated Q2 net profit to ₹468 crore and a 22% increase in revenue to ₹5,873 crore. Operating EBITDA rose 37% as the company reached its 1,000th Zudio store milestone, keeping institutional sentiment buoyant despite broader consumer discretionary multiple compression.
news.impact: Tight sideways base building above the ₹3,000 psychological mark provides an actionable high-tight flag setup for trend followers.

news.headline: CG Power Outlines Capacity Expansion Across Transformers and Switchgear as Order Intake Jumps 78%
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions approved a ₹68 crore capital expenditure to expand power transformer capacity by 10,000 MVA to 75,000 MVA, alongside enhanced switchgear lines. The expansion follows a 78% YoY jump in Q2 order intake that drove its unexecuted backlog to a record ₹23,646 crore, led by robust power transmission demand.
news.impact: Massive backlog expansion underpins medium-term earnings trajectory, offering swing accumulation potential on dips toward its 50-DMA support.
